claims: Kennesaw State University (KSU) is a public university.
Kennesaw State University has two main campuses.
Kennesaw State University's two main campuses are located in suburban Cobb County, Georgia.
Kennesaw State University's two main campuses are located roughly 15-20 miles northwest of Atlanta.
Kennesaw State University's main campus is in Kennesaw.
Kennesaw State University's main campus address is 1000 Chastain Road, Kennesaw, GA 30144.
Kennesaw State University's second campus is in Marietta.
Kennesaw State University's second campus address is 1100 South Marietta Pkwy, Marietta, GA 30060.
Kennesaw Campus is often referred to as the main campus.
Kennesaw Campus is located near the historic Kennesaw Mountain National Battlefield Park.
Marietta Campus was formerly Southern Polytechnic State University.
Marietta Campus is located in Marietta, Georgia.
Marietta Campus serves as the home for many engineering and technical programs.
Both campuses of Kennesaw State University are within the metro Atlanta area
